name.zh: 2000年11月19日，《中共中央办公厅、国务院办公厅关于转发<民政部关于在全国推进城市社区建设的意见>的通知》印发
name.en: The Circular of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Forwarding the Opinions of the Ministry of Civil Affairs on Promoting Urban Community Construction Nationwide issued on November 19, 2000

name.zh: 2004年10月4日，《中共中央办公厅转发<中共中央组织部关于进一步加强和改进街道社区党的建设工作的意见>的通知》印发
name.en: The Circular of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee Forwarding the Opinions of the Organization Department of the CPC Central Committee on Further Strengthening and Improving the Party Building Work in Sub-districts and Communities was issued on October 4, 2004

name.zh: 2001年7月，民政部在青岛召开全国城市社区建设工作会议
name.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs held the National Urban Community Construction Work Conference in Qingdao in July 2001

name.zh: 2002年9月8-9日，民政部召开全国城市社区建设四平现场会议，标志着全国社区建设已经迈入新的、更高的发展阶段
name.en: The Ministry of Civil Affairs held the National Urban Community Construction On-site Meeting in Siping in 8-9 September 2002, marking a new and higher stage of national community development

name.zh: 2003年9月26日，为构建学习型社会，推进学习型社区建设，民政部、中央文明办、国家新闻出版总署、国家广播电影电视总局组织开展“全国万家社区图书室援建和万家社区读书活动”
name.en: To build a learning-oriented society and advance the development of learning-oriented communities, the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Central Civilization Office, the General Administration of Press and Publication, and the State Administration of Radio, Film and Television launched the national campaign of "Constructing 10,000 Community Libraries and Launching 10,000 Community Reading Programs" on September 26, 2003

name.zh: 2000年12月，新疆维吾尔自治区社区建设现场会
name.en: December 2000, On-site Conference on Community Construction in Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

name.zh: 2001年4月27日，时任民政部部长多吉才让在黑龙江省哈尔滨市道里区视察社区建设工作
name.en: April 27, 2001, Doje Cering, then Minister of Civil Affairs, inspected community construction work in Daoli District, Harbin, Heilongjiang Province
